_schema_note: positions.<TICKER> fields: executed_tier (0/1/2/3), current_stage (IDLE/TIER1/TIER2/TIER3), last_triggered_at (ISO8601 or null), rsi_peak (max T-1 daily RSI seen this profit cycle), hourly_rsi_peak (max intraday Hourly RSI seen this profit cycle, tracked separately from rsi_peak since they're different timeframes), highest_price_since_buy, last_avg_cost, last_shares. last_avg_cost/last_shares/rsi_peak/hourly_rsi_peak/highest_price_since_buy are refreshed every run regardless of whether a new tier triggered. A reset (avg_cost/shares changed, or T-1 close below avg_cost) clears rsi_peak/hourly_rsi_peak/highest_price_since_buy back to null along with executed_tier/current_stage, since a new profit cycle starts fresh. A ticker missing from positions is first-run init, not a reset. last_heartbeat_date (YYYY-MM-DD, America/New_York) is set only after a confirmed-successful daily heartbeat Telegram send; a run that finds it stale retries on its next trigger rather than assuming the message went out.
